_about: René Descartes (1596-1650) in English, translator per row. Raw IA OCR: Haldane and Ross's Philosophical Works, vol. I (Cambridge, 1911). Clean Gutenberg: the first English Discourse of a Method (London: Thomas Newcombe, 1649; translator unnamed). Vol. II of Haldane and Ross (first published 1912) is wanted: the only scans found are 1931 and 1934 reprints (post-1930 printings, Adam's open class). Veitch's Method and Meditations are on the Adler shelf, his Principles on singles-ideas, and Molyneux's Six Metaphysical Meditations (1680) on singles-ideas-3; none is taken again. No uids minted.
